lines:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant B as Core Invocation Broker
    participant A as Core Authority and Approval
    participant G as Approved Invocation Gateway
    participant E as External Agent Manager
    participant X as Codex App Server or ACP Agent
    participant N as Result Normalizer
    B->>G: Approved start envelope with pinned target and scope
    G->>E: ExternalAgentStartV1
    E->>X: Initialize and negotiate lifecycle features
    X-->>E: Native capability set
    E->>N: ExternalAgentCapabilitySetV1
    N-->>G: Exact supported and unsupported facts
    G-->>B: Capability facts
    E->>X: Start bounded task
    X-->>E: Native session id and progress
    E->>N: NativeSessionRefV1 and progress
    N-->>G: Normalized session and progress events
    G-->>B: HostInvocationEventV1
    opt External agent requests approval
        X-->>E: Native approval request
        E->>N: ExternalApprovalRequestV1
        N-->>G: Approval request event
        G-->>B: Approval request without a grant
        B->>A: Evaluate against frozen authority
        A-->>B: Approved denied or user decision required
        B->>G: Generation-fenced ApprovalResolutionV1
        G->>E: Forward core resolution
        E->>X: Native approval response
    end
    opt Later approved continuation
        B->>G: Approved continuation with retained NativeSessionRefV1
        G->>E: ExternalAgentContinueV1
        alt Continuation was negotiated and session matches
            E->>X: Continue native session
            X-->>E: Progress and terminal result
        else Unsupported or native session lost
            E->>N: Explicit capability or session failure
        end
    end
    B->>G: CancelInvocationV1
    G->>E: ExternalAgentControlV1 cancel
    E->>X: Native cancel when supported
    alt Cancellation positively confirmed
        X-->>E: Native cancel confirmation
        E->>N: Cancellation evidence and any known effects
    else Unsupported refused disconnected or unconfirmed
        E->>N: Unconfirmed cancellation and opaque effect state
        N-->>G: OutcomeUncertain when terminal facts are missing
    end
    G-->>B: Normalized terminal outcome
    Note over A,E: Only the core grants approval and missing features are never simulated

data.title: External Agent Negotiation, Approval, Continuation, and Cancellation
